articles.title: Researchers Find Six 0-Days Allowing Unauthorized Takeover of Supermarket Refrigeration Systems
articles.summary:
Six pre-authentication remote code execution flaws were found in the Danfoss AK-SM800A supermarket fridge controller, allowing remote takeover in about an hour, according to Midnight Blue researcher Carlo Meijer. The flaws are stack-based buffer overflows. They affect every firmware version up to and including 5.3.2, and no CVE numbers have been assigned yet. Since October […]
